rationale: The primary limiter is duplication of SecondSol's scaled marketplace and service stack combined with unproven Polish unmet volume and sparse part-number liquidity. The single redesign converts the candidate into an installer-facing resolution desk that searches OEM and incumbent channels before sourcing qualified reclaimed supply, concentrating the business on documented inverter and optimizer cases where fitment avoids repowering. This changes the control point and economic path without claiming supplier rights, customer commitments, pricing, margin, or validation.
